risk_summary: The disclosure is quantitatively detailed and presents a strongly confident outlook, supported by comparable-store sales, margin, revenue-mix, and commodity-cost metrics. Key risks include commodity inflation, challenging consumer conditions, execution of the CPG direct-distribution transition, international expansion, and increased capital expenditures, although forward guidance remains somewhat generalized.
